answer: A bond is refunded only after 14 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The summit counter is kept in copper and plume shows each reset. A hostile operator therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 14 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 358 aliases cost 290 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
